source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: ZIPFoundation exposes zipItem and unzipItem via FileManager+ZIP.swift, which rely on the Archive class and its reading, writing and ZIP64 extensions. Compression goes through Data+Compression.swift, which uses libcompression on Apple or zlib via the CZLib module on Linux.
